name: sre-harness
description: Read-only harnesses for review learning and specification consistency. Collects GitHub review history into structured lessons and improvement candidates that a person approves, traces decisions and requirements across open pull requests, and checks IaC delivery records against a state-transition and evidence contract, with a sample Rego risk classification of Terraform plans, and keeps a rebuildable knowledge index that returns only the approved norms that apply to one task, within an access filter and a token budget. Run data stays outside the repository; nothing is pushed, merged or applied.
